body:
Thanks for the report! This is an automated first-pass triage; a maintainer will make the final call.

**Reproduction:** Black 25.11.0 (default flags, snippet from the report): unstable (`INTERNAL ERROR: ... produced different code on the second pass of the formatter`). 25.11.0 is also the latest release as of the issue date, so no newer version was tried. I did not check the older versions you say worked.
**Assessment:** The error reproduces with the snippet as given. It looks like unstable formatting involving `# fmt: off` / `# fmt: on` written inside commented-out lines (`# # fmt: off`) within a list literal.
**Next step:** If you can, please say which Black version last formatted this file without error. That would help a maintainer narrow down the change.

<sub>black-issue-triage skill v1.0.0 · suggested for maintainers: none</sub>
